body:
Smerdyakv (smerdyakv@aol.com) wrote:
:         Dan, the name of the group "alt.fan.unabomber" is misleading.  The
: vast majority are not fans -- indeed, the vast majority feel the same as
: you.  It is merely a forum where people discuss the "true crime" aspects
: of the matter, as well as the political views the bomber advanced.  (And I
: personally agree with you that given that he is a murderer,  no one should
: bother engage him in his views, regardless of the merit or lack thereof).

Please refrain from reading or posting in this group if you are not a
true fan of the mystical and awe-inspiring UNABOMBER.  The vast majority
of legitimate users here are interested in furthering the revolutionary
goals of FC.  Readers of the Manifesto know that FC did not advance 
political views as you claim above.

193. The kind of revolution we have in mind will not necessarily involve
     an armed uprising against any government.  It may or may not involve
     physical violence, but it will not be a POLITICAL revolution.  Its
     focus will be on technology and economics, not politics.

You are painfully unaware of what you speak, another victim of television
and mass media information flooding, seeking entertainment instead of
an understanding of the world around you.

-Ric
